reviewer: armor_native independent lane; reviewed pinned instructions without importing artifact_probe
confirmedClaims: Duration scalar consumes XMM0 as internal float32 Power, normalizes via b8f610, multiplies max(q*a,0) by0.25 then adds1; no powf call in this scalar.

Boots/Mushroom/IronHide/Gong/Shadow inspected callsites load item+0x480 into XMM1 before b903e0; dispatcher passes those bits to configured callback via by-reference float. Displayed integer Power is absent from these callsites.
Boots constructor explicitly populates PowerEffects[0] with DurationIncrease class; mere class registration elsewhere does not establish every candidate instance uses it.
Inspected duration callsites multiply the selected callback result by a base duration from item-type+0x9c, preserving binary32 instruction order.
3ca070 writes float to spec+0x1e0 named SetByCaller map record+8 under nonzero key. This is a duration payload, not direct final active lifetime storage.

StatusDuration calculation 7b0ab0 reads SetByCaller key44844a8, selects a captured factor by positive/negative tag outcome, and multiplies at7b0ca7; default factor1 alone does not validate missing capture as known neutral.

Native builder+0xac is transported through caller stack+0x78→constructor entry+0x80/ rbp+0xd8→item-type+0x9c, while +0xa8→+0x70→rbp+0xd0→+0x98. Boots1.5 and IronHide8 native defaults thus have a static arithmetic/transport explanation.

findings.detail: Artifact manifest callback functor span ends a7a3a8 before the actual tail jump. jmp rax at a7a3a8 is three bytes; exclusive end must be at least a7a3ab.

Numeric base default claim needs builder b6508f call and item-type constructor prolog/store spans, not just argument loads. Independent reviewer inspected these and confirmed mapping; author asked to include compact spans.

claimBoundaries: Five unsupported native duration-class cohort members are not five fully calculable artifacts. Tome and Shielding currently establish constructor class use; their complete activation/duration path was not reviewed.
No per-item instance state, original asset/exe same-build authenticity, live gameplay, or independent raw holdouts were established.
SetByCaller payload cannot be labeled final active duration without custom calculation, tag capture, effect application and gameplay lifetime handling.
This review is static and independent of artifact author; no independent emulation or game oracle was supplied.
